```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)

base_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-11-24/"
locations <- read_csv(paste0(base_url, "locations.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
production_locations <- read_csv(paste0(base_url, "production_locations.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
productions <- read_csv(paste0(base_url, "productions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

periods <- tibble(
  period = 1:7,
  label = c("Before 1920", "1920–1945", "1946–1959", "1960–1975", "1976–1999", "2000–2012", "2013–"),
  start = c(-Inf, 1920, 1946, 1960, 1976, 2000, 2013)
)

links <- production_locations |>
  left_join(productions, by = "production_id") |>
  left_join(locations, by = "location_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(year)) |>
  mutate(
    period = findInterval(year, periods$start),
    decade = pmax(year %/% 10 * 10, 1900),
    continent = countrycode::countrycode(country_code, "iso2c", "continent", warn = FALSE),
    other = !(country_code %in% c("US", "CA") | continent %in% "Europe")
  )

# Spherical mean: average the 3D unit vectors, then project back to lon/lat
sph_mean <- function(df, by) {
  rad <- pi / 180
  df |>
    mutate(
      x = cos(latitude * rad) * cos(longitude * rad),
      y = cos(latitude * rad) * sin(longitude * rad),
      z = sin(latitude * rad)
    ) |>
    summarise(n = n(), across(c(x, y, z), mean), .by = {{ by }}) |>
    mutate(lat = atan2(z, sqrt(x^2 + y^2)) / rad, lon = atan2(y, x) / rad)
}

centroids <- links |>
  sph_mean(period) |>
  left_join(periods, by = "period") |>
  arrange(period)

decades <- links |>
  sph_mean(decade) |>
  arrange(decade)

places <- links |>
  count(period, location_id, other, lon = longitude, lat = latitude)

# Stops outside North America and Europe, keyed by Wikidata ID
stops <- tribble(
  ~id,         ~location_id, ~period,
  "baku",      "Q9248",      1,
  "hong_kong", "Q8646",      5,
  "ooty",      "Q9888",      5,
  "sydney",    "Q3130",      6,
  "wadi_rum",  "Q40729",     7,
  "istanbul",  "Q406",       7
) |>
  left_join(select(locations, location_id, name, lon = longitude, lat = latitude), by = "location_id") |>
  left_join(count(links, location_id, period), by = c("location_id", "period"))

# Share of links outside the US, Canada and Europe
other_share <- links |>
  summarise(share = mean(other), .by = period) |>
  left_join(periods, by = "period") |>
  arrange(period)

istanbul_tv <- links |>
  filter(location_id == "Q406", period == 7) |>
  summarise(share = mean(kind == "tv")) |>
  pull(share)

fmt <- \(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
pct <- \(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%")
n_links <- \(p) fmt(centroids$n[p])
n_stop <- \(s) stops$n[stops$id == s]

ojs_define(
  places_data = places |> select(period, other, lon, lat, n),
  decade_data = decades |> select(decade, lon, lat, n),
  centroid_data = centroids |> select(period, label, lon, lat, n),
  stop_data = stops |> select(id, name, lon, lat)
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
topojson = require("topojson-client@3")

world = fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/land-110m.json").then(r => r.json())
land = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.land)

accent = "#2457C5"
ink = "#1E1E1E"
paper = "#ECEEF0"
graphite = "#4A4E53"
dotColor = "#3A3D41"
size = Math.min(width || 800, 860)
home = [-40, 50]
moveMs = 1400

proj = d3.geoOrthographic()
  .rotate([-home[0], -home[1]])
  .fitExtent([[10, 10], [size - 10, size - 10]], {type: "Sphere"})

geoPath = d3.geoPath(proj)

places = transpose(places_data)
cents = transpose(centroid_data)
decs = transpose(decade_data)
stopsById = new Map(transpose(stop_data).map(s => [s.id, s]))

// One entry per trigger in the section, in document order
steps = [
  {kind: "title"},
  {kind: "intro"},
  {kind: "period", period: 1},
  {kind: "stop", period: 1, stop: "baku"},
  {kind: "period", period: 2},
  {kind: "period", period: 3},
  {kind: "period", period: 4},
  {kind: "period", period: 5},
  {kind: "stop", period: 5, stop: "hong_kong"},
  {kind: "stop", period: 5, stop: "ooty"},
  {kind: "period", period: 6},
  {kind: "stop", period: 6, stop: "sydney"},
  {kind: "period", period: 7},
  {kind: "stop", period: 7, stop: "wadi_rum"},
  {kind: "stop", period: 7, stop: "istanbul"},
  {kind: "decades"},
  {kind: "elsewhere", center: [50, 20]},
  {kind: "end"}
]

idx = Math.min(crTriggerIndex ?? 0, steps.length - 1)
stepInfo = steps[idx]
period = stepInfo.period ?? null
stop = stepInfo.stop ? stopsById.get(stepInfo.stop) : null

// Where the moving average sits, kept across steps so an interrupted move resumes from there
view = ({pos: null})

targetOf = s => s.center ?? (s.stop ? [stopsById.get(s.stop).lon, stopsById.get(s.stop).lat] : home)

radius = d3.scaleSqrt().domain([1, d3.max(places, d => d.n)]).range([1, 10])

mapSvg = {
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("width", size).attr("height", size).style("display", "block")

  const defs = svg.append("defs")

  // Pencil wobble: strong on the base map, light on trails and rings
  const wobble = (id, scale) => {
    const f = defs.append("filter").attr("id", id).attr("x", "-5%").attr("y", "-5%").attr("width", "110%").attr("height", "110%")
    f.append("feTurbulence").attr("type", "fractalNoise").attr("baseFrequency", 0.03).attr("numOctaves", 2).attr("seed", 1)
    f.append("feDisplacementMap").attr("in", "SourceGraphic").attr("scale", scale)
  }
  wobble("boil", 9)
  wobble("sketch", 3)

  // Diagonal pencil hatching for land
  defs.append("pattern").attr("id", "hatch").attr("width", 5).attr("height", 5)
    .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse").attr("patternTransform", "rotate(40)")
    .append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("y1", 0).attr("x2", 0).attr("y2", 5)
    .attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 0.9).attr("stroke-opacity", 0.55)

  const base = svg.append("g").attr("filter", "url(#boil)")
  base.append("path").attr("class", "geo").datum({type: "Sphere"})
    .attr("fill", paper).attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 1.4)
  base.append("path").attr("class", "geo").datum(d3.geoGraticule10())
    .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 0.4).attr("stroke-opacity", 0.35)
  base.append("path").attr("class", "geo").datum(land)
    .attr("fill", "url(#hatch)").attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 1)
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "places")
  svg.append("path").attr("class", "trail").attr("filter", "url(#sketch)")
    .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 2).attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
  svg.append("path").attr("class", "dec-trail").attr("filter", "url(#sketch)")
    .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 1.5).attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "decs")
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "cents")
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "stops")
  return svg.node()
}

// Line boil: a new noise seed about twice a second
_boil = {
  const turb = d3.select(mapSvg).selectAll("feTurbulence")
  const timer = d3.interval(() => turb.attr("seed", () => 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)), 300)
  invalidation.then(() => timer.stop())
}

front = d => {
  const r = proj.rotate()
  return d3.geoDistance([d.lon, d.lat], [-r[0], -r[1]]) < Math.PI / 2
}

positionPlaces = () => {
  d3.select(mapSvg).selectAll(".places circle")
    .attr("cx", d => proj([d.lon, d.lat])[0])
    .attr("cy", d => proj([d.lon, d.lat])[1])
    .attr("display", d => front(d) ? null : "none")
}

// Places change with the step only
_places = {
  const kind = stepInfo.kind
  const shown = kind === "intro" ? places
    : kind === "elsewhere" ? places.filter(d => d.other)
    : period ? places.filter(d => d.period === period) : []
  d3.select(mapSvg).select(".places").selectAll("circle")
    .data(shown, d => `${d.period}|${d.lon}|${d.lat}`)
    .join(
      enter => enter.append("circle")
        .attr("r", 0).attr("fill-opacity", 0.35)
        .call(e => e.transition().duration(500).attr("r", d => radius(d.n))),
      update => update,
      exit => exit.call(e => e.transition().duration(300).attr("r", 0).remove())
    )
    .attr("fill", kind === "elsewhere" ? accent : dotColor)
  positionPlaces()
}

// Each step turns the globe and slides the average over moveMs, whatever the scroll speed
_view = {
  const svg = d3.select(mapSvg)
  const kind = stepInfo.kind
  const done = kind === "end"
  const p = done ? cents.length : (period ?? 0)
  const past = cents.filter(c => c.period < p)
  const goal = p >= 1 ? [cents[p - 1].lon, cents[p - 1].lat] : null
  const from = view.pos ?? goal
  const posAt = from && goal ? d3.geoInterpolate(from, goal) : () => goal

  // Turn the shorter way round
  const r0 = proj.rotate().slice(0, 2)
  const to = targetOf(stepInfo)
  const r1 = [-to[0], -to[1]]
  r1[0] = r0[0] + ((((r1[0] - r0[0]) % 360) + 540) % 360) - 180
  const rotAt = d3.interpolate(r0, r1)

  const draw = k => {
    proj.rotate(rotAt(k))
    svg.selectAll("path.geo").attr("d", geoPath)
    positionPlaces()

    const pos = posAt(k)
    view.pos = pos

    svg.select("path.trail")
      .attr("d", pos ? geoPath({type: "LineString", coordinates: [...past.map(c => [c.lon, c.lat]), pos]}) : null)

    const marks = [
      ...past.map(c => ({...c, current: false})),
      ...(pos ? [{...cents[p - 1], lon: pos[0], lat: pos[1], current: !done}] : [])
    ]

    svg.select(".cents").selectAll("g.cent")
      .data(marks, d => d.period)
      .join(enter => {
        const g = enter.append("g").attr("class", "cent")
        g.append("circle").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
        g.append("text")
          .attr("x", 12).attr("y", 4)
          .attr("font-family", "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace")
          .attr("fill", ink)
          .attr("paint-order", "stroke").attr("stroke", paper).attr("stroke-width", 3)
        return g
      })
      .attr("transform", d => `translate(${proj([d.lon, d.lat])})`)
      .attr("display", d => front(d) ? null : "none")
      .each(function(d) {
        const s = d3.select(this)
        s.select("circle").attr("r", d.current ? 8 : 4).attr("fill", d.current ? accent : paper)
        s.select("text")
          .text(d.current || done ? d.label : "")
          .attr("font-size", d.current ? 15 : 11)
          .attr("font-weight", d.current ? 600 : 400)
      })

    // Decade averages, drawn one after another
    const shownDecs = kind === "decades" ? decs.slice(0, Math.ceil(k * decs.length)) : []
    svg.select("path.dec-trail")
      .attr("d", shownDecs.length > 1 ? geoPath({type: "LineString", coordinates: shownDecs.map(d => [d.lon, d.lat])}) : null)
    const labelled = new Set([1900, 1910, 1960, 1990, 2020])
    svg.select(".decs").selectAll("g.dec")
      .data(shownDecs, d => d.decade)
      .join(enter => {
        const g = enter.append("g").attr("class", "dec")
        g.append("circle").attr("r", 3.5).attr("fill", paper).attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 1.2)
        g.append("text")
          .text(d => labelled.has(d.decade) ? `${d.decade}s` : "")
          .attr("x", 8).attr("y", 4)
          .attr("font-family", "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace").attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", ink)
          .attr("paint-order", "stroke").attr("stroke", paper).attr("stroke-width", 3)
        return g
      })
      .attr("transform", d => `translate(${proj([d.lon, d.lat])})`)
      .attr("display", d => front(d) ? null : "none")

    // Stop marker fades in as the globe arrives
    svg.select(".stops").selectAll("g.stop")
      .data(stop ? [stop] : [], d => d.id)
      .join(enter => {
        const g = enter.append("g").attr("class", "stop")
        g.append("circle").attr("r", 15).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 2.2).attr("filter", "url(#sketch)")
        g.append("text")
          .text(d => d.name)
          .attr("x", 20).attr("y", 5)
          .attr("font-family", "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace")
          .attr("font-size", 15).attr("font-weight", 600).attr("fill", ink)
          .attr("paint-order", "stroke").attr("stroke", paper).attr("stroke-width", 3)
        return g
      })
      .attr("transform", d => `translate(${proj([d.lon, d.lat])})`)
      .attr("display", d => front(d) ? null : "none")
      .attr("opacity", k)
  }

  svg.interrupt("move")
  draw(0)
  svg.transition("move").duration(moveMs).ease(d3.easeCubicInOut).tween("move", () => draw)
}

chart = {
  const nLinks = d3.sum(places, d => d.n).toLocaleString("en-US")
  const wrap = htl.html`<div style="position:relative;width:${size}px;">`
  wrap.appendChild(mapSvg)
  wrap.appendChild(htl.html`<div class="edge-strip">▸ The center of film ▸ Wikidata P915 ▸ ${nLinks} links ▸ 1887–2028 ▸</div>`)
  return wrap
}
```
:::

<span class="cr-title-h1">The center of film</span><span class="cr-title-sub">Where films and series were shot, period by period</span><span class="cr-hint">Scroll, or press p and use the arrow keys</span> [@cr-map]

Wikidata links `r fmt(nrow(links))` films and series to the places they were shot. The blue dot is the average of each period's locations, measured on the globe. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">01 ▸ Before 1920 ▸ `r n_links(1)` links</span>Fort Lee, New Jersey, has more links than any other place, ahead of New York. Hollywood comes later. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Baku, Azerbaijan</span>`r n_stop("baku")` links before 1920, more than anywhere else outside North America and Europe. Two are 1898 films of oil gushers. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">02 ▸ 1920–1945 ▸ `r n_links(2)` links</span>Los Angeles takes over, but European studios keep the average out over the ocean. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">03 ▸ 1946–1959 ▸ `r n_links(3)` links</span>Pinewood Studios, west of London, now has more links than any city. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">04 ▸ 1960–1975 ▸ `r n_links(4)` links</span>Pinewood, home of the early Bond films, still leads. The average reaches its easternmost point, just north of Ireland. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">05 ▸ 1976–1999 ▸ `r n_links(5)` links</span>Los Angeles and New York lead again, and the average moves back west. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Hong Kong</span>`r n_stop("hong_kong")` links in these years, the most outside North America and Europe. Among them are *Police Story* and *Chungking Express*. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Ooty, India</span>A hill station in Tamil Nadu. Its `r n_stop("ooty")` links include *Roja* and *Kuch Kuch Hota Hai*. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">06 ▸ 2000–2012 ▸ `r n_links(6)` links</span>Los Angeles still leads, and the average barely moves. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Sydney, Australia</span>Two Star Wars prequels and both Matrix sequels were shot here. `r n_stop("sydney")` links in these years. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">07 ▸ 2013– ▸ `r n_links(7)` links</span>The average moves east again, to a point south of Iceland. Los Angeles still has the most links. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Wadi Rum, Jordan</span>The desert stood in for Mars in *The Martian* and for Arrakis in *Dune*. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Istanbul, Turkey</span>`r n_stop("istanbul")` links since 2013, the most outside North America and Europe. `r pct(istanbul_tv)` of them are TV series. [@cr-map]

Split by decade, the average goes west in the 1910s, east by the 1960s, west again in the 1990s and back east since. [@cr-map]

Every place outside North America and Europe, all periods together. Their share of links grew from `r pct(other_share$share[1])` before 1920 to `r pct(other_share$share[7])` since 2013, not enough to pull the average off the North Atlantic. [@cr-map]

:::{focus-on="cr-map"}
All seven averages together.
